content.markdown: All render styles in order. `styles[0]` is the **implicit default** used when the SNL source omits `[style]`. In `foo[bar](x)`, the parser picks the style whose `tag === "bar"`; unknown tags are a render-time error. Every macro has at least one style. Style tags follow `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` (parser IDENT rules) and must be unique within this array.
